_comment: TANK ACCUMULATOR sleeve — active 'buy the tank, sell the bounce' + melt-ice-cube backstop. Holds a CORE (never sold); strikes with dry powder when a WATCH name has fallen a lot (drawdown ladder + deep RSI(2)); trims the opportunistic tranche back on the bounce; if nothing tanks for backstop_days, deploys a chunk into the core so cash never rots. Long-only (cash account). Sizes off the tank sleeve budget in allocation.py. Edit knobs here, git push.

_param_help.unit_dollars: $ per ladder 'unit'. A 4-unit deep tank buys 4x this. Scale with the account.
_param_help.dd_ladder: drawdown from the hi_lookback-day high -> target UNITS. Deeper fall = more units = bigger buy.
_param_help.rsi_tank: RSI(rsi_len) below this adds +1 unit (deep-oversold kicker).
_param_help.trim_rsi: on a bounce (RSI back above this, OR close above the ma_exit-day mean) TRIM the opportunistic tranche (core untouched).
_param_help.max_names: max simultaneous opportunistic tank positions (concentration cap).
_param_help.cooldown_days: min days between adds/trims on one name.
_param_help.backstop_days: if NO tank buy fires for this many days, deploy backstop_dollars into core[0] (melt-ice-cube: buy the melt-up so cash doesn't rot).
_param_help.backstop_dollars: $ deployed into the core when the backstop fires.
